title: Plan document source
description: plans/documents/<docid>.json, schema 1.1 -- one document a position plan may be drawn on, as Woodcore imports it (v0.114, calc/domains/plan_documents.py, docs/domain/position-plans.md §3.3sexies): an architect's PDF, an image, an SVG or a CAD drawing, kept where it is in the project and never copied. Written by Woodcore only. Its pages are cut into plans, each plan naming the document and a page (`background.document`, plan-source 1.2). Since 1.1 (v0.116) it may say which tab it belongs to (`owner`).

id.description: The document's id, D01, D02, ...: its file name.

name.description: What the engineer calls the document, free text; may be empty.

group.description: The folder Woodcore files this source in, "" or absent at the root -- a field and never a directory, as on every source.

file.description: Its path relative to the project folder, with forward slashes; a .pdf, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .svg, .dxf or .dwg inside the folder.

kind.description: What the file is: a PDF, an image (PNG, JPEG), an SVG, or a CAD drawing (DXF, or a DWG converted to DXF by the ODA File Converter).

sha256.description: The file's SHA-256 when it was imported or last refreshed.

pages.description: Every page of the document, from 1: a PDF's pages; a CAD drawing's layouts, the model space first then the paper-space layouts in their tab order; one page for an image or an SVG.

rotation.description: The rotation the engineer gave the page, degrees clockwise -- 0, 90, 180 or 270 -- on top of a PDF's own /Rotate.

layout.description: A CAD drawing's page: the name of its layout (Model, or a paper-space layout).

layers_off.description: The names of the layers switched off -- a PDF's optional-content groups, a CAD drawing's layers -- one list for the whole document: the window renders without them and the report takes them out (plan_documents.flatten_page).

owner.description: The tab the document belongs to, the one that imported it (v0.116): `plan` the position plans', `fire` the fire protection plans'. Each tab lists its own documents only. Absent (a document written before 1.1): the position plans', unless every plan drawn on it is a fire protection plan with a frame of its own (calc/domains/plan_pages.py, document_owner).
